accuracy_modifier.validation_rule: accVaries, RACC, or MACC tempMod increased

clone_interaction.failure_mode: clone_sync state unchanged on Kurogane WS

damage_modifier.failure_mode: no offensive tempMod or atkVaries delta recorded
damage_modifier.validation_rule: temporary WSD/MAB/atkVaries modifier applied during WS execution

debuff_apply.validation_rule: target debuff or nativeDebuff context registered

elemental_followup.failure_mode: elemental follow-up did not fire on damaging WS

enmity_modifier.failure_mode: ENMITY tempMod missing or wrong sign
enmity_modifier.validation_rule: ENMITY tempMod applied with expected sign (positive tank / negative utility)

ftp_modifier.failure_mode: ftpMod unchanged at 1.0 or below expected rank curve
ftp_modifier.validation_rule: params.ftpMod exceeds normalized 1.0 baseline according to rank curve

heal_modifier.failure_mode: heal not executed or violated role cap
heal_modifier.validation_rule: HP recovery executed within role cap (never on pure DPS)

hit_count_modifier.failure_mode: hit count remained 1 or multiHitfTP remained false
hit_count_modifier.validation_rule: params.numHits or multiHitfTP increased per rank

mp_gain.failure_mode: no MP recovery triggered when below max MP
mp_gain.validation_rule: attacker MP restored post-WS (unless at max MP)

next_ws_primer.validation_rule: OX_NEXT_WS_* localVars set with future expiry

pet_interaction.failure_mode: pet present but received no heal/TP delta
pet_interaction.validation_rule: active pet received HP/MP heal or TP gain

resource_build.validation_rule: Soul localVar or Conduction gauge incremented up to cap

stance_conditional.failure_mode: failed to activate when stance active, or activated when condition false
stance_conditional.validation_rule: activates when stance/jobSpec/petAlive condition holds; reports condition_not_met otherwise

status_apply.failure_mode: status buff not applied or blocked by role guardrail
status_apply.validation_rule: self or party status effect applied with duration > 0

tp_bonus.failure_mode: effectiveTp equaled raw TP without bonus
tp_bonus.validation_rule: effectiveTp increased above raw TP (capped at 3000)

tp_gain.failure_mode: zero TP refund or party TP granted post-WS
tp_gain.validation_rule: attacker or party TP increased post-WS

wsc_modifier.failure_mode: stat WSC remained 0 despite invested rank
